planets.name: Qatar-1 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Qatar-1 with a 1.42-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: Qatar-1 b was found in 2010 by Qatar as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Qatar-1. Its orbit and size follow Collins et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
